설명: 디 마허 은(는) 다음을 테마로 하는 보드게임입니다: seven sequential political races in different regions of Germany., 디 마허 은(는) 다음을 테마로 하는 보드게임입니다: seven sequential political races in different regions of Germany. 플레이어 맡아 조율하며 national political parties, 한정된 자원 를 활용해 당을 승리. 가장 높은 승점 를 달성한 팀이. 다양한 방식으로 점수 계산 승점. 선거 결과에 따라 one to eighty 승점, 득표율과 영향력에 따라 차등 획득합니다. 또한 선거에서 승리하면 a regional election 미디어 영향력 포인트를 획득합니다, then the party will receive some media-control 승점. 당원 수가 증가함에 따라 추가 보너스 점수를 획득합니다 승점. Lastly, in some editions, parties 점수 some 승점 if their party platform matches the national opinions 게임이 종료되면 the game.

The 1986 edition (Hans im Glück) 주요 4개 정당이 참여하며 from the old West Germany and 3~4명의 플레이어를 지원합니다
The 1997 edition (Moskito Spiele) supports up to five 플레이어 in the re-united Germany and updated several features of the 규칙 as well
The 2006 edition (Valley Games) also supports up to five 플레이어 and adds a shorter five-라운드 variant and additional 규칙 updates by the original designer
The 2019 edition (Indie Game Studios/Spielworxx Kickstarter) 게임 규칙을 간소화하고 and adds a four-라운드 option

게임명: 사무라이, 사무라이, Samurai

메커니즘: 타일 놓기, 셋 컬렉션, 육각형 격자, 핸드 관리, 영역 둘러싸기, 지역 다수 / 영향력, 게임당 1회 능력, 가변 게임 준비, 비공개 승점

설명: Samurai is set in medieval Japan., Samurai is set in medieval Japan. 플레이어 compete to gain the favor of three f액션: samurai, peasants, and priests, which are represented by helmet, rice paddy, and Buddha figures scattered about the board, which features the islands of Japan. The competition is waged through the use of hexagonal 타일, each of which help curry favor of one of the three f액션 — or all three at once! 플레이어 can make lightning-quick strikes with horseback ronin and ships or approach their conquests more methodically. As each figure (helmets, rice paddies, and Buddhas) is sur라운드ed, it is awarded to the 플레이어 who has gained the most favor with the corresponding group.

Gameplay continues until all the symbols of one type have been removed from the board or four figures have been removed from play due to a tie for influence.

게임이 종료되면 the game, 플레이어 compare captured symbols of each type, competing for majorities in each of the three types. Ties are not uncommon and are broken based on the number of other, "non-majority" symbols 각 플레이어는 has collected.

The game is part of what is sometimes called the Knizia 타일-laying trilogy.

게임명: 어콰이어, 어콰이어, Acquire

메커니즘: 타일 놓기, 주식 보유, 핸드 관리, 패턴 만들기, 승점을 자원으로 사용, 게임 종료 보너스, 연결, 시장, 수입, 투자, 정사각형 격자, 비공개 승점

설명: In Acquire, 각 플레이어는 전략적ally invests in businesses, trying to retain a majority of stock., In Acquire, 각 플레이어는 전략적ally invests in businesses, trying to retain a majority of stock.  As the businesses grow with 타일 배치s, they also start merging, giving the majority stockholders of the acquired business sizable bonuses, which can then be used to reinvest into other chains.  All of the investors in the acquired company can then cash in their stocks for current value or trade them 2-for-1 for shares of the newer, larger business.  The game is a race to acquire the greatest wealth.

History of Acquire: This Sid Sackson classic has taken many different forms over the years depending on the publisher, yet the 규칙 and game play have stayed the same. The 1966 version of the 3M bookshelf edition included 규칙 for a 2-플레이어 variant. The original version is part of the 3M Bookshelf Series.

Many books and websites incorrectly list this as a 1962 publication as the 3M Company used previously copyrighted artwork when they released the game in 1964. 3M actually received the idea for the game of "Vacations" from Sid Sackson in May of 1963 and decided to take his idea and put it into artwork they had developed the year before for a game called "ACQUIRE." 3M's original game idea for a game called ACQUIRE must not have been very good so they decided to take Sid's idea of Vacations and put it into their concept of ACQUIRE. They released some limited test market games in 8 Midwestern U.S. cities in December of 1963 with a box that had a 1963 copyright. These games had Sid's original 규칙. When 3M released the mass market games in 1964, they had developed some of Sid's original ideas and changed some 규칙 and game play to match their production desires. They released them with outer boxes that were copyrighted 1962 and inner boxes with 규칙 that were dated 1963.

December 1963 - Test Market World Map Wood 타일 Edition
1964 - Dated 1962/63 wood 타일, chipboard with plastic overlay & stocks with printed backs
1965 - Dated 1962/63 plastic 타일, chipboard with plastic overlay & stocks with printed backs (last edition made with printed backs until 1999)
1966 - Dated 1962/66 plastic 타일, chipboard with plastic overlay & non-wax coated stocks (Only edition with these stocks)
1968 - Dated 1968/66 plastic 타일, clear plastic board with paper underlay (Both 1966 inner box games have a lot of mixed parts)
1971 - Dated 1968/71 plastic 타일, yellow hard plastic board
1975 - 3M sells rights for game of ACQUIRE to the Avalon Hill Company
1976 - Dated 1976 plastic 타일, yellow hard plastic board, redesigned money, no inner box (This edition was also produced in 1977, 79, 81, 82,       & 86)
1989 - Dated 1976 Gray box edition with new box artwork same contents as regular 1976 editions (This edition was also produced in 1992)
1995 - Dated 1995 Large box 카드board edition with chipboard board and 타일, Special Powers Variant 타일 inspired by German editions
1997 - Avalon Hill sells the rights to the game of ACQUIRE to Hasbro
1999 - Dated 1999 Large box with large plastic board and 타일, 3D company buildings, redesigned stocks & money, large info 카드
2006 - Hasbro assigns rights for the game of ACQUIRE to their subsidiary, Wizards of the Coast
2006 - Lloyd's (private) 규칙 of ACQUIRE are made public, two major 규칙 changes that help to bring the balance of the game of ACQUIRE back to the  intentions of Sid Sackson's original ideas. Lloyd 1인전n's 규칙 help 플레이어 to correct poor strategy during the beginning of the game that can been seen with new and unexperienced 플레이어 (running out of money soon is the main mistake that must be omitted!).
2008 - Dated 2008 카드board edition with chipboard board & 타일, redesigned stocks & money
2016 - Dated 2016 The current affordable mass-market edition. It looks at first sight to be similar to previous modern editions, but has been criticised for the use of inferior design choices such as hard-to-read grey-on-grey embossed slots and the unusual 타일 fonts. It contains modified 규칙 and a slightly smaller playing grid. Although these changes have been criticised for not ultimately improving upon Sackson's original design, they are generally regarded as not being too damaging to it.
2023 - Renegade Game Studio partners with Hasbro, and releases their new version, with Classic Mode or Tycoon Mode — play with or without tertiary stockholder merger bonus.
2024 - The Renegade 60th Anniversary edition includes a set of plastic weighted poker chips, and Special Powers Variant 카드.

게임명: 보난자, 보난자, Bohnanza
영문명: Bohnanza
메커니즘: 셋 컬렉션, 거래, 핸드 관리, 협상, 다용도 카드
카테고리: 가족
테마: 카드 게임, 농업, 협상
설명: Bohnanza is the first in the Bohnanza family of games and has been published in several different editions, including a 2023 version with flowers., Bohnanza is the first in the Bohnanza family of games and has been published in several different editions, including a 2023 version with flowers.

This entry lists a few different major 카드 sets for Bohnanza: the base game for 3-5 플레이어, the expanded game with the same name for 2-7 플레이어 (that is, first 확장판 included), and Bohnanza Pocket.

In the game, you plant, then harvest bean 카드 in order to earn coins. 각 플레이어는 starts with a hand of random bean 카드, and each 카드 has a number on it corresponding to the number of that type of beans in the deck. Unlike in most other 카드게임, you can't rearrange the order of 카드 in hand, so you must use them in the order that you've picked them up from the deck — unless you can trade them to other 플레이어, which is the heart of the game.

On a 턴, you must plant the first one or two 카드 in your hand into the "fields" in front of you. Each field can hold only one type of bean, so if you must plant a type of bean that's not in one of your fields, then you must harvest a field to make room for the new arrival. This usually isn't good! Next, you reveal two 카드 from the deck, and you can then trade these 카드 as well as any 카드 in your hand for 카드 from other 플레이어. You can even make future promises for 카드 received right now! 모든 the trading is complete — and all trades on a 턴 must involve the active 플레이어 — then you end your 턴 by drawing 카드 from the deck and placing them at the back of your hand.

When you harvest beans, you receive coins based on the number of bean 카드 in that field and the "beanometer" for that particular type of bean. Flip over 1-4 카드 from that field to transform them into coins, then place the remainder of the 카드 in the dis카드 pile. When the deck runs out, shuffle the dis카드, playing through the deck two more times. 게임이 종료되면 the game, everyone can harvest their fields, then whoever has earned the most coins wins.

The original German edition supports 3-5 플레이어. The English version from Rio Grande Games comes with the first edition of the first German 확장판 included in a slightly oversized box. One difference in the contents, however, is that bean #22's Weinbrandbohne (Brandy Bean) was replaced by the Wachsbohne, or Wax Bean. This edition includes 규칙 for up to seven 플레이어, like the Erweiterungs-Set, but also adapts the two-플레이어 규칙 of Al Cabohne in order to allow two people to play Bohnanza.

게임명: 라, 태양신 라, Ra

메커니즘: 셋 컬렉션, 경매 / 입찰, 운 시험하기, 제한 입찰, 경매: 1회 순환, 폐쇄 경제 경매, 비공개 승점

테마: 고대, 신화
설명: Ra is an auction and set-collection game with an Ancient Egyptian theme., Ra is an auction and set-collection game with an Ancient Egyptian theme.  Each 턴 플레이어 are able to purchase lots of 타일 with their bidding 타일 (suns).  Once a 플레이어 has used up his or her suns, the other 플레이어 continue until they do likewise, which may set up a situation with a single uncontested 플레이어 bidding on 타일 before the end of the 라운드 occurs.  Tension builds because the 라운드 may end before all 플레이어 have had a chance to win their three lots for the epoch.  The various 타일 either give immediate 점수, prevent negative 점수 for not having certain types 게임이 종료되면 the 라운드 (epoch), or give 점수 after the final 라운드.  The game lasts for three "epochs" (라운드).  The game is easy to learn.

From the Box:
The game spans 1500 years of Egyptian history in less than an hour!
The 플레이어 seek to expand their power and fame and there are many ways to accomplish this: Influencing Pharaohs, Building monuments, Farming on the Nile, Paying homage to the Gods, Advancing the technology and culture of the people. Ra is an auction and set collecting game where 플레이어 may choose to take risks for great rewards or... And all this is for the glory of the Sun God Ra!

게임명: 카탄, 카탄, Catan
영문명: Catan
메커니즘: 거래, 조립 보드, 육각형 격자, 핸드 관리, 주사위 굴림, 네트워크 및 경로 건설, 직접 공격, 경주, 가변 게임 준비, 시장, 수입, 무작위 생산, 연쇄 작용, 비공개 승점
카테고리: 가족, 전략
테마: 경제, 협상
설명: In CATAN (formerly The Settlers of Catan), 플레이어 try to be the dominant force on the island of Catan by building settlements, cities and roads., In CATAN (formerly The Settlers of Catan), 플레이어 try to be the dominant force on the island of Catan by building settlements, cities and roads. On each 턴 주사위 are rolled to determine which 자원 the island produces. 플레이어 build structures by 'spending' 자원 (sheep, wheat, wood, brick and ore) which are represented by the relevant 자원 카드; each land type, with the exception of the unproductive desert, produces a specific 자원: hills produce brick, forests produce wood, mountains produce ore, fields produce wheat, and pastures produce sheep.

Set-up includes randomly placing large hexagonal 타일 (each depicting one of the five 자원-producing terrain types--or the desert) in a honeycomb shape and sur라운드ing them with water 타일, some of which contain ports of exchange. A number disk, the value of which will correspond to the roll of two 6-sided 주사위, are placed on each terrain 타일. 각 플레이어는 is given two settlements (think: houses) and roads (sticks) which are placed on intersections and borders of the terrain 타일. 플레이어 collect a hand of 자원 카드 based on which terrain 타일 their last-placed settlement is adjacent to. A robber pawn is placed on the desert 타일.

A 턴 consists of rolling the 주사위, collecting 자원 카드 based on this 주사위 roll and the position of settlements (or upgraded cities—think: hotels), 턴ing in 자원 카드 (if possible and desired) for improvements, trading 카드 at a port, possibly playing a development 카드, or trading 자원 카드 with other 플레이어. If the 주사위 roll is a 7, the active 플레이어 moves the robber to a new terrain 타일 and steals a 자원 카드 from another 플레이어 who has a settlement adjacent to that 타일.

점수 are accumulated by building settlements and cities, having the longest road or the largest army (from some of the development 카드), and gathering certain development 카드 that simply award 승점. When a 플레이어 has gathered 10 점수 (some of which may be held in secret), s/he announces this and claims the win.

게임명: 카르카손
영문명: Age of Renaissance
메커니즘: 경매 / 입찰, 지역 이동, 시뮬레이션
카테고리: 전략
테마: 문명, 경제, 중세, 르네상스
설명: A game that is often described as a semi-sequel to Civilization., A game that is often described as a semi-sequel to Civilization.

플레이어 attempt to build up their cultures during the Middle Ages and Renaissance periods. The game features a 카드 deck that holds events, payout 카드, and famous leaders of the particular eras. Although all 카드 will 턴 up somewhere during the game, the timing and position in which they will be played is crucial and will ensure a different game every time.

The main goal of each city-state is to gain 점수 in the form of technical advances, while keeping their culture's misery level as low as possible. The payout structure is similar to those of Civilization and Advanced Civilization in that more 자원 of the same type yield increasingly higher payouts. This time particular payouts are triggered by 카드 play for every 플레이어 at once. An ingenious and very smooth working “combat” system is implemented to determine province – and thus 자원 - control.

게임명: 티그리스 & 에우프라테스, 티그리스 & 유프라테스, Tigris & Euphrates
영문명: Tigris & Euphrates
메커니즘: 타일 놓기, 셋 컬렉션, 핸드 관리, 지역 다수 / 영향력, 직접 공격, 전력 강제 투입, 연결, 최고·최저 점수 계산, 수입, 정사각형 격자, 연쇄 작용, 비공개 승점
카테고리: 전략
테마: 추상전략, 문명, 고대, 영역 건설
설명: Regarded by many as Reiner Knizia's masterpiece, Tigris & Euphrates is set in the ancient fer타일 crescent with 플레이어 building civilizations through 타일 배치., Regarded by many as Reiner Knizia's masterpiece, Tigris & Euphrates is set in the ancient fer타일 crescent with 플레이어 building civilizations through 타일 배치. 플레이어 are given four different leaders: farming, trading, religion, and government. The leaders are used to collect 승점 in these same categories. However, your 점수 게임이 종료되면 the game is the number of 점수 in your weakest category, which encourages 플레이어 not to get overly specialized. Conflict arises when civilizations connect on the board, i.e., external conflicts, with only one leader of each type surviving such a conflict. Leaders can also be replaced within a civilization through internal conflicts.

Starting in the Mayfair edition from 2008, Tigris & Euphrates included a double-sided 게임 보드 and extra 구성품 for playing an advanced version of the game. This "ziggurat 확장판", initially released as a separate item in Germany for those who already owned the base game, is a special monument that extends across five spaces of the board. The monument can be built if a 플레이어 has a cross of five civilization 토큰 of the same color by dis카드ing those five 토큰 and replacing them with the ziggurat markers, placing a ziggurat tower upon the middle 타일. The five ziggurat markers cannot be destroyed. All 규칙 regarding monuments apply to the ziggurat monument as well. If your king is inside the kingdom of the ziggurat, you will get one 승점 in a color of your choice 게임이 종료되면 your 턴.

Some versions of Tigris & Euphrates are listed as being for 2-4 플레이어, while others incorrectly state that they're for 3-4 플레이어. Tigris & Euphrates is part of what is sometimes called Reiner Knizia's 타일-laying trilogy.

게임명: 프어우도, 페루도, Perudo

설명: Liar's 주사위, a.k.a., Liar's 주사위, a.k.a. Bluff, Perudo or Dudo, is a South American 주사위 game in which 각 플레이어는 is given five 주사위 and cup to roll and hide them with. 플레이어 make successively higher declarations regarding the results of all the 주사위 remaining in the game, e.g. "there are ten sixes". However, someone can always contest the bid. When that happens, all the 주사위 are revealed and either the bidder or the caller loses 주사위, depending on who was correct. The last 플레이어 with 주사위 is the 승리자.

As a public domain 주사위 game, there are a number of variants or similar games called Liar's 주사위. This includes one that is often played with Poker 주사위, and differs from the marketed versions in that 플레이어 only declare on their own hand's value (as opposed to all 주사위 being in play), using poker-hand values.

게임명: 메디시, 메디치, Medici

설명: Another Reiner Knizia standby, this game plays very well with varying numbers of people., Another Reiner Knizia standby, this game plays very well with varying numbers of people.  The object is to accrue the most 점수 during three 라운드, which you do by spending your 점수 to bid on sets of 카드.  Each 턴 the current 플레이어 턴 up one to three 카드 for all the 플레이어 to bid on, with the highest bid taking all 카드.  The 카드 denote a commodity type and quantity/value.  The 라운드 ends when 각 플레이어는's ships are full, or the commodity 카드 deck is exhausted.  After each 라운드, 점수 are awarded to 각 플레이어는 having the most of a given commodity, and to the one with the most valuable total "cargo load".

Part of the Knizia auction trilogy.

설명: This is a negotiation game in the truest sense of the word., This is a negotiation game in the truest sense of the word. In it, 플레이어 acquire ownership of sections of city blocks then place 타일, representing businesses, onto the block-sections.  게임이 종료되면 each 턴, each 타일 you've laid gives you some sort of payout, but completed businesses (formed of three to six connected 타일 of the same type) pay quite a bit better.  All these 자원 are dealt to the 플레이어 randomly, however, so 플레이어 must trade to get matching businesses and adjacent locations.

This game is #2 in the Alea big box series.

게임명: 로스트 시티즈, 로스트 시티, Lost Cities
